props.name: seed
props.description: The terrain's seed. The same seed always makes the same map; changing it generates a new one.

props.name: onSeedChange
props.description: Called with the new seed when the map is regenerated from the button or the handle.

props.name: roughness
props.description: 0–1. Low rolls like downland; high is all crags. Sets the Hurst exponent of the diamond–square noise.

props.name: waterLevel
props.description: 0–1. The fraction of the height range under water.

props.name: tone
props.description: `terrain` bands water, sand, grass, rock and snow from the accent and ink; `accent` is one hue; `ink` is greyscale.

props.name: fog
props.description: Distance fog, 0–1. At 0 only the far edge fades, so the draw distance never shows as a line.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplies the flight speed. 1 is a steady cruise.

props.name: quality
props.description: Controlled quality: internal resolution, draw distance and how fine the far samples are.

props.name: onQualityChange
props.description: Called when the quality buttons change it.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Steer by dragging and, when focused, with the keyboard. Off, it is a picture that flies itself.

props.name: autoFly
props.description: Fly on its own along a weaving, terrain-following path. Off, the camera hovers until steered. Ignored under reduced motion.

props.name: paused
props.description: Hold the flight still. The view can still be turned by hand.

props.name: map
props.description: Show the overview map with your position and heading.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the view. An empty string on a non-interactive terrain makes it decorative.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the pause, regenerate and quality controls under the view.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect ratio of the view.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn on top — a headline in the sky. It does not take the pointer unless it asks for it.
